task.prompt: Generate a complete sparse softmax decode-row system from signed Q/K/V to result AND selected mask under the exact supplied algorithm contract. Prefer compatible native library reuse with linked_reference_ids and thin generated adapters; inspect integrated bundles if useful. Reuse must preserve exact contract math. Start from a correct compact implementation; one-query-per-cycle throughput is not required. All algorithm parameters are chosen by Kernel from measured profiles and can be revisited by Critic. No manually supplied system plan or previous generated RTL.

baseline.purpose: artifact revalidation, not another autonomous optimization run
